svg.title: Model reports accumulate around three investigators
svg.desc: Stack model reports around the same three investigators and retain links back to source context. More analysis pages should increase review burden, not automatically signify confidence. Place the evidence-lane wall behind the foreground review work, marking the on-premises setting without asserting complete access.
